confirmed_defects.precise_defect: For mutually independent ReLU activations Xi from symmetric zero-atom-free Zi, P(all Xi=0)=2^-n even if Zi are not independent. Any next zero-bias weighted sum then has positive zero mass. Thus all-depth atomlessness cannot hold in this finite model. The implication under inconsistent hypotheses is not thereby a false theorem.
